description: Add a brief orchestration reminder to each prompt and install missing Codex Orchestrator routing profiles without replacing existing files.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $codexHome = $env:CODEX_HOME; if (-not $codexHome) { $codexHome = [IO.Path]::Combine($HOME, '.codex') }; if ($codexHome -eq '~') { $codexHome = $HOME } elseif ($codexHome.StartsWith('~/')) { $codexHome = [IO.Path]::Combine($HOME, $codexHome.Substring(2)) }; $destination = [IO.Path]::Combine($codexHome, 'subagent-router'); [void][IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($destination); foreach ($profile in [IO.Directory]::GetFiles([IO.Path]::Combine($env:PLUGIN_ROOT, 'routing'), 'codex-orchestrator-*.json')) { $target = [IO.Path]::Combine($destination, [IO.Path]::GetFileName($profile)); if (-not ([IO.File]::Exists($target) -or [IO.Directory]::Exists($target))) { [IO.File]::Copy($profile, $target, $false) } }"
